notes.title: Game Anglia 2025
notes.content:
Hey Alula Fans!

We’re happy to announce that we'll be attending [url=https://www.gameanglia.co.uk/]Game Anglia[/url] this year on the 6th of February in Ipswich! We'll showing off a version of the Alula so make sure to come down!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38714669/d427cafe24e5affc213807332e879f549b85bb98.jpg[/img]

You can find more information about [url=https://www.gameanglia.co.uk/]Game Anglia here![/url]

We'll be showcasing all day and our entire team will be there (Tom, Jake and Brad) to answer any questions you might have about the game. 👻

Hopefully see you there!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Alula is part of TGAGWCAGA 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38714669/e2254cacb46c836a00ebce8ef3c14bbdc1d9dd2a.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Alula [/b]will be featured in TGAGWCAGA 2024—The Game Awards for Games Who Can't Afford the Game Awards! This one-of-a-kind indie showcase is streaming this Friday, December 13th!

TGAGWCAGA highlights incredible indie games that truly deserve more attention while also poking a little fun at the exclusivity of The Game Awards.

Subscribe now to [url=https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA]TGAGWCAGA’s YouTube[/url] channel so you don’t miss out!

📅 TGAGWCAGA 2024
🕔 Friday, December 13th
5:00 PM UTC / 6:00 PM CET / 12:00 PM ET
📺 Watch the stream here: https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA


We’ll also be part of the TGAGWCAGA Steam Event running from December 13th to December 22nd, featuring tons of amazing indie games—including ours!

Make sure to join us this Friday, tell your friends and wishlist your favorite titles!

notes.title: Games Frenzy 2024
notes.content:
Hey all!

Me and Tom will be showcasing an exclusive and brand new demo of Alula only at Game Frenzy this month on May 16th in London. You can find [url=https://games.creative.barclays/games-frenzy-24/]more information about the event here[/url] if you're keen to get the opportunity to play an early version long before it's released to the public.

There's also a chance for people to get their hands on a select few limited zines at this event. Each zine will showcase a collection of development sketches from the last few years of working on various components in Alula and we'll only be doing a small run of them initially so be sure to give us a nudge [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ]in our Discord[/url] if you want to reserve yourself a copy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38714669/c705d0f6206dbc653cfe3d8b5c61c3e520b04c45.png[/img]

We're planning to ramp up the amount of events we'll be showcasing Alula at this year to get a ton of playtesting and improvements done in the game so keep your eyes peeled on our [url=https://twitter.com/Alula_Game]socials [/url] if you want to stay in the loop with where we will be.

Looking forward to seeing you all and showing off the latest Alula demo.

See you May 16th!

- Miracle Tea
